sn35.242:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kimmilāyaṃ viharati gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre.
sn35.242:1.2: addasā kho bhagavā mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānaṃ
sn35.242:1.4: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave amuṃ mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānanti.
sn35.242:1.6: evaṃ vutte āyasmā kimmilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.242:1.9: idha kimmila bhikkhu aññataraṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā na vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati
